verdict.rationale: Glama is an MCP registry, hosting and gateway platform, so versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents API versioning or any deprecation policy, and probes for an OpenAPI spec at the standard paths all returned 404. The 'stable' ownership token in the connector schema is a different feature and does not address API versioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
